research_rationale:
EO 12916 (59 FR 25779, signed 1994-05-13) implements the BECC and North American Development Bank agreement and the community adjustment and investment provisions of the NAFTA Implementation Act. I read the held Federal Register text in full (jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12916.txt, an OCR text layer, read against EO 13380). The inventory is sections 1-11 in 18 clauses. EO 13380 (signed 2005-06-17, no separate effective date, so effective on signing; 70 FR 35509) inserted words in section 1; struck section 2 and inserted a new section 2; struck subsections 3(a), 3(b) and 3(c), the designation (d), and replaced representatives in what remains; replaced Advisory Committee in section 6; and changed Members to members in section 7(c). Under the owner's strike-and-insert ruling of 2026-10-21 clauses whose words are replaced continue as amended (sections 1, 3(d), 6, 7(c)). The original sections 2(a), 2(b), 2(c), 3(a), 3(b) and 3(c) were struck and are not carried into replacement text, so those six clauses are recorded as terminated on 2005-06-17 by express amendment; a human reviewer should note the substance of section 2 changed. Sections 4, 5, 7(a), 7(b), 8, 9, 10 and 11 are not touched by any held instrument. EO 14354 (2025-09-29) continues the Good Neighbor Environmental Board under Executive Order 12916 until September 30, 2027, recorded as a continuation event on section 10.
